mapper.insert: INSERT INTO access_log (visitor_id, appointment_id, entry_time, exit_time, access_status, device_name, fail_reason, create_time) VALUES (#{visitorId}, #{appointmentId}, #{entryTime}, #{exitTime}, #{accessStatus}, #{deviceName}, #{failReason}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT a.*, v.name AS visitor_name, v.phone AS visitor_phone FROM access_log a LEFT JOIN visitor v ON a.visitor_id = v.id WHERE a.id = #{id}

SELECT a.*, v.name AS visitor_name, v.phone AS visitor_phone FROM access_log a LEFT JOIN visitor v ON a.visitor_id = v.id
AND (v.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR v.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND a.access_status = #{accessStatus}
ORDER BY a.create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE access_log SET exit_time = #{exitTime} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT a.*, v.name AS visitor_name, v.phone AS visitor_phone FROM access_log a LEFT JOIN visitor v ON a.visitor_id = v.id WHERE a.visitor_id = #{visitorId} AND DATE(a.entry_time) = CURDATE() LIMIT 1

SELECT a.*, v.name AS visitor_name, v.phone AS visitor_phone FROM access_log a LEFT JOIN visitor v ON a.visitor_id = v.id WHERE a.entry_time IS NOT NULL AND a.exit_time IS NULL ORDER BY a.entry_time ASC

SELECT a.*, v.name AS visitor_name, v.phone AS visitor_phone FROM access_log a LEFT JOIN visitor v ON a.visitor_id = v.id WHERE a.entry_time IS NOT NULL AND a.exit_time IS NULL AND a.entry_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{thresholdHour} HOUR) ORDER BY a.entry_time ASC
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT visitor_id) FROM access_log WHERE DATE(entry_time) = CURDATE() AND access_status = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM access_log WHERE entry_time IS NOT NULL AND exit_time IS NULL AND access_status = 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT visitor_id) FROM access_log WHERE YEAR(entry_time) = YEAR(NOW()) AND MONTH(entry_time) = MONTH(NOW()) AND access_status = 1
